task: Replacing a light switch plate cover
query: How do I replace a light switch plate cover?

goal.title: Replace a plain light-switch plate with a patterned plate
goal.description: Collect the patterned replacement plate and screwdriver, operate a breaker at the electrical panel and illuminate the work area with a phone. Unscrew and remove the plain switch plate, then position the patterned cover, repeatedly adjust its fit and tighten the mounting screws. Return to the breaker panel, then test the wall switch by watching the ceiling light turn on and off.
goal.final_state: The sports-patterned plate is attached around the switch. After revisiting the electrical panel, the person toggles the switch and the ceiling light visibly changes between on and off.
procedure: Collect the replacement switch plate and screwdriver.
Operate the circuit breaker and use the phone light at the wall switch.
Loosen both mounting screws and remove the old plain plate.
Align the patterned replacement plate and try fitting its mounting screw.
Remove and reposition the cover, then tighten its mounting screws.
Return to the breaker panel and test the switch with the room light.

phases.description: Pick up the patterned plate, operate the breaker and approach the switch using light from the phone.
Use a screwdriver and the fingertips to loosen the plate screws. Pull the plain plate off the wall and place it aside.
Adjust the phone, collect the replacement plate and start fitting its mounting screws. Remove and tilt the plate during repeated alignment attempts, then reseat it around the switch.
Tighten the remaining mounting screw, release the plate and make further turns on the lower fastener.
Return to the breaker panel and operate the breaker, walk back and open the door. Toggle the new plate’s switch and inspect the ceiling light as it changes state.
